to: Description Built for effortless everyday wear, the Griffin Stripe T-Shirt blends understated heritage with reliable, hard-wearing comfort. Crafted from a substantial 190 gsm organic cotton, it delivers a clean drape that holds its shape wash after wash. The five-colour variegated pattern is yarn-dyed directly into the knit rather than printed, keeping the fabric naturally soft, breathable, and free of stiff synthetic prints. Finished with a practical chest pocket, it seamlessly transitions from a casual Friday at work straight into an evening out.
